structure.biological_identity: synthetic (Pro-Pro-Gly) collagen-mimetic trimer, not a native fish or viral protein functional model
structure.locator: Abstract, crystal-structure description and 1K6F deposited assembly coordinates

forcefield.name: Amber ff14SB + TIP3P
forcefield.read_level: primary paper text via indexed PMC and abstract; actual XML files parsed by OpenMM
forcefield.scope: standard Pro/Gly templates; no custom hydroxyproline or invented residue parameters

method_precedent.locator: Materials and methods: ff14SB collagen-like peptides, explicit OPC, PME, Langevin, source-specific restraints
method_precedent.used_for: supports tractability of standard-residue collagen-mimetic ff14SB simulation
method_precedent.differences: Our 1K6F modeled87residue trimer, TIP3P,1fs,no mass repartitioning,no nucleus restraint,short100ps CUDA production are not that paper's setup or reproduction

forcefield_limit.used_for: force-field and water-pair choice affect collagen structural predictions; our pair not empirically benchmarked here

fin_relevance.read_level: full text via public Jina after direct challenge
fin_relevance.locator: Results and Discussion: actinotrichia migration, elongation, insertion and degradation in fin growth
fin_relevance.used_for: collagen scaffold biological relevance only; no molecular or mechanical calibration

engine.locator: pip CUDA platform plugin and installation checking

equations.dynamics: m_i dv_i/dt = -grad_i U - gamma m_i v_i + sqrt(2 gamma m_i kB T) xi_i(t), with holonomic HBond/rigid-water constraints
equations.potential: Parameterized all-atom ff14SB bonded terms, Lennard-Jones and Coulomb electrostatics with PME; exact numeric Hamiltonian serialized in system.xml
equations.force_control: F_i = -dU/dx_i checked by central finite difference on an actual nonzero solute force component
equations.RMSD: sqrt(mean_i ||R(x_i-mean x)-(y_i-mean y)||^2), minimized over proper rotations R, C-alpha atoms
equations.end_distance: Euclidean separation of first and last modeled C-alpha in each chain, nm; not contour length or Young modulus

validation_scope: Numerical/parameterization checks only. No measured held-out molecular trajectory, mechanical assay, fibril or fish tissue data used for calibration. Empirical accuracy and cross-scale transfer unknown.
